turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so it's totally quiet in here, like, do you need help with anything else?

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. Grab a knife and help me with these potatoes.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: On it, I'll totally get those peeled and ready in no time!

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Don't rush it, kid, or you'll take a finger off.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe I should eat something soon, but this data is... it's almost finished.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: Of course, my dear Moth, one cannot expect the intellect to flourish while the stomach is nothing but a hollow, aching void.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think... well, it's probably more about the focus, but the tea does smell quite nice.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: Naturally, the fragrance is merely a courtesy, whereas the sustenance is a necessity for your continued survival.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: That is a good haul, Tuk. Put it in the freezer.

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Good meat. Tuk will bring it in soon.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Negative. I will stay on this post until my shift ends.

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Then Tuk will go and put it away.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: Of course, my dear Nate, this stew is repeating its previous mistakes with remarkable consistency.

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. Eat the stew or leave it for someone who actually appreciates a hot meal.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: One does not merely appreciate a hot meal, my dear; one expects it to possess a modicum of variety.

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: If you want variety, go find a different cook.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe the dog startled me, but it's alright, I'm fine.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I brought these leaves for the animals, and they're totally fresh, like, really fresh...

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: The herb leaves look good, and I think they'll be enough for now.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: I'll take these back to the pen then, since they're good for them!

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Pip, do not sit there all day. The animals need feeding.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I'm totally doing it, I'm just, like, watching the calf for a second...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: The calf will be ready for the knife soon enough.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: That is totally harsh, like, it's just a baby...

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Loosen your grip on the rifle, Pip. You are squeezing the trigger too hard.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I am totally trying, but like, the rifle is just so heavy...

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: It is a tool, not a burden. Adjust your stance.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Like this? It feels totally weird when I move my feet.

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. Back's gone stiff. Get the rice, Pip.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so that sounded totally bad, like, are you okay Nate?

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: I'm fine. Just grab the rice and get back to work.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: You are totally lying, your face looks like it hurts!

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I totally just sliced my hand on the wire, it's like, really stinging...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Stop pulling at it, Pip. Tuk will clean the cut.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: It's not even that bad, like, it's just a little stingy...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Small cuts grow thick and red if you let them.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe you should take the painkillers, because the bleeding... it's not stopping.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Negative. It is only a single puncture. Just finish the stitching.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: It's not just a puncture, the artery is... well, it's close to the edge.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Just stitch it and be done.
